children: Aptos said its first testnet reset is scheduled for October 7. The testnet will return to its initial state, clearing deployed contracts, test accounts, balances, and history, and requiring redeployment.
According to Foresight News, the reset will not affect the mainnet or devnet.
Aptos said the testnet has processed more than 10 billion transactions, which has increased storage usage. Regular resets are intended to keep storage at a manageable level.

title: Aptos Plans First Testnet Reset for October 7
